For the Petitioner/s : Md Naushaduzzoha, Advocate

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Chandra Bhushan Prasad, APP  Mr. Sanjay Kumar Sharma, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 15-04-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned APP for the State along with learned counsel appearing on behalf of the O.P. No.2.
2.

The petitioner seeks bail in anticipation of his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 379, 307/34 of the Indian Penal Code and 3/4 of the D.P.
Act.
3.
The learned counsel for the parties jointly submits that the matter be referred for mediation.
4. In view of the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, the matter is referred to the Mediation Center, Patna High Court.

5. The petitioner and the O.P. No.2 along with their Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.19597 of 2024(2) dt.15-04-2024 respective learned counsels shall remain physically present before the Mediation Center of the Patna High Court on 29.04.2024, so that the matter is referred to a learned mediator for resolving the dispute amicably.
